reason: This is a small diff in count but it touches central planner range-derivation code (`pkg/util/ranger`) plus point-get planning/execution paths. `LIKE` range building on new collations is semantics-sensitive and can cause wrong access ranges, missed/incorrect point gets, or wrong query results across many statements.
